Privacy: body (## = heading, - = bullet, {email} = contact email)

This policy explains what personal information we collect when you register as a volunteer, why we collect it and how it is protected.
## Information we collect Through the volunteer registration form we collect your name, contact details, optional personal and professional details, volunteer interests and availability, an emergency contact, and your consent. We ask only for what we need to coordinate volunteers.
## How we use it - To review your registration and contact you about volunteer opportunities, events and community initiatives. - To contact your emergency contact if needed during activities. - To keep records of volunteer participation.
## Storage and access Registrations are stored in IOF's secure registration system and are accessible only to authorised IOF staff. Data is sent over encrypted connections. We do not sell your information.
## Sharing We do not share your personal information with third parties except where required by law.
## Your choices You may ask to see, correct or delete your information, or withdraw your consent to be contacted, by emailing {email} and quoting your registration reference.
## Contact Questions about this policy: {email}.

Terms: body (## = heading, - = bullet, {email} = contact email)

## Use of this website This website is provided by India Overseas Forum (IOF) to share information about our activities and to register volunteers. Please use it lawfully and do not attempt to disrupt or misuse it.
## Volunteer registration By registering you confirm that the information you provide is true and accurate and that you voluntarily agree to take part in IOF Seva activities. Registration does not guarantee a volunteer role; IOF may review, accept or decline registrations.
## Accuracy of information General guidance on this site (for example on passports or Iqama services) is not official advice. Always confirm requirements with the relevant embassy or authority.
## Changes We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site means you accept the updated terms.
## Contact Questions: {email}.
